name: Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi

benefits.name: Damage & Theft Purchase Protection
benefits.description: May cover repairs or reimbursement if purchases made with the card are damaged or stolen within 120 days (90 days for New York residents) of purchase or delivery.

benefits.name: Worldwide Car Rental Insurance
benefits.description: May cover theft or damage to a rental car when the rental is paid for with the card and the rental company's collision loss/damage insurance is declined.

benefits.name: Travel & Emergency Assistance
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency travel arrangement assistance and referrals. Referrals/assistance are at no cost, but the cardholder pays for any services used.

benefits.name: Roadside Assistance Dispatch Service
benefits.description: Dispatches roadside help in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The cardholder is responsible for the cost of any services provided.

earningRates.terms: 5% on gas at Costco and 4% on other eligible gas/EV charging share a combined $7,000/year spend cap; earnings drop to 1% after the cap is reached.
4% on other eligible gas and EV charging (outside Costco). Shares a combined $7,000/year cap with the 5% Costco gas rate; earnings drop to 1% after the cap is reached.
3% on restaurants and eligible travel, including Costco Travel.
2% on all other Costco and Costco.com purchases.
1% on all other purchases, and on gas/dining/travel spend once the relevant cap is exceeded.
